mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers imminent Fed tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5% (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and expansion in non-farm payrolls signals tightening labor market, accelerating corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regime with HOUST above 1000 thousand units and RSAFS growth exceeding 0.5% MoM accelerates consumer spending, boosting corporate revenue and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 105 (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, increasing corporate earnings visibility and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105 (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.5% signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.5% (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown regime with INDPRO growth below 0.3% MoM signals weakening demand, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.3% MoM (10-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL YoY above 2.0% signals dovish policy response to inflation, compressing real rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (10-year rolling window).
